svg.title: Nacre transport and logistics — road, rail, and sea
svg.desc: Fourteen freight and passenger routes connect ten Nacre terminals. Roads, railways, and sea routes use different line styles. Freight-only and passenger-only routes are labeled, and diamond markers indicate intermodal transfer terminals.
svg.text: Truck and coach roads, railways, cargo boats, and passenger ferries
Schematic routes and terminals · Basemap adapted from the Synthetic Exercise World atlas
Routes without F or P carry both services.
See the guide for transfer services by terminal.
